alerts.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
alerts.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) instructs browsers to only connect over HTTPS.
alerts.evidence: Strict-Transport-Security header is absent on HTTPS URL
alerts.impact: Users could be downgraded to insecure plain HTTP via SSL-stripping MITM attacks.

alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps detect and mitigate Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection.
alerts.impact: Absence of CSP reduces defense-in-depth against XSS and unauthorized script execution.
alerts.solution: Implement a restrictive CSP such as default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'.

alerts.name: Server Banner / Version Information Disclosure
alerts.description: The server header discloses technical version details.
alerts.impact: Assists attackers in profiling target software stacks and matching known CVE vulnerabilities.
alerts.solution: Configure reverse proxy or web server to suppress granular version banners.
